description: What the Word editor of office-com-host.ps1 (Apply-WordOperation and the 41 operations of Invoke-WordOperation with office-word-formatting.ps1) asks Word and answers: each operation with the argument sets the live Word tests use, every documented refusal, with and without an author, with tracking on and off, appended runs of 1, 2 and 5 paragraphs with mixed formatting, Korean and global numbering, tables with each borders form, in background batches and in live batches with a failure mid-batch (the Undo(1) and touched rules). The call log is cut at the operation markers; the replay (tests/word_edit.rs) holds the Rust editor to the same call sequence and the same results. Not covered until a document is added as an input: set_content_control on a control that exists (a document with a content control cannot be made by the operations), add_comment_reply on a Word without threaded replies, set_comment_resolved on a Word without the Done property.

scenarios.description: append_text alone, then runs of 2 and of 5 paragraphs with mixed formatting (one insertion, formatting per group of equal style and properties, one result per paragraph).
Lists on appended paragraphs: bullets, global and Korean numbering, listContinue, levels, none, a named style kept on the item, the inset of an indented item.
Run, paragraph and border formatting on appended paragraphs: fonts, borders on each side, tab stops, spacing and exact line spacing, keep and break flags, indents, shading.

replace_text with shared word edges and more than one match, set_paragraph_text, move_paragraph (up, down, to the end), remove_paragraph, add_image at the end and after a paragraph, set_font, set_paragraph_style (a style the document lacks), set_paragraph_format with a list and a border, set_list.

operations.text: The old way, the old way.

scenarios.description: Comments, replies, provenance, resolved state and deletion; tracked changes with and without an author; resolving by author, all at once, by index; the reviewers note when an author matches nobody.
set_document_font, define_styles (built-in styles by id, one the document lacks) and fonts through styles.

Headers and footers (kind and variant), page numbers (alone, with a prefix and a total, over an existing footer line), the table of contents, breaks (page, section, column, at the end), a hyperlink, a bookmark, notes, page setup.

operations.text: Revenue grew in the quarter and 92.8% of it recurred.

scenarios.description: add_table in each form (plain, styled with a missing style, header rows, column alignments, widths and natural widths, row heights, every borders form, shading, a total row, row styles, repeatHeader and headerBold off, at a paragraph), the cell, style, merge, row and column operations and fit_table.
Every documented refusal of the Word operations, each in a batch of its own so each failure text is recorded.
fill_template over the body and a header, with particles first and then the token variants (spacing inside the braces), counted by matches; a token without a value stays and is listed.
A live batch on a document the user holds: one undo record, undoUnits 1, appended paragraphs joined as one run.
A live batch that fails after it changed the document: Undo(1) takes it back.
A live batch that fails before it touched the document: nothing is undone.
A live batch with an author: the user name and initials are restored afterwards.
